pages.alt: A percentage bar. Above it, a bracket marks the old amount, 100 percent equals 150 pounds. It is shaded to 120 percent. Below it, a bracket marks the new amount, 120 percent equals 180 pounds. Inside the bar, the rise is named, plus 20 percent. At the foot: 150 times 1.2 equals 180 pounds, with times 1.2 highlighted.
pages.name: Up 20%
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{fill:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="247.69" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="247.69" y1="22" x2="247.69" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="133.84" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = £150</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="273.23" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="272.23" height="38" rx="1"/><g><line x1="247.69" y1="37" x2="247.69" y2="75" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2px"/></g><g><text x="270.46" y="53" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">+20%</text><text x="270.46" y="69" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">£30</text></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="293.23" y2="86" class="s2"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s2"/><line x1="293.23" y1="81" x2="293.23" y2="91" class="s2"/></g><g><rect x="88.76" y="94" width="135.69" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="156.61" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">120% = £180</text></g><g><rect x="212.86" y="128" width="54.19" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="177.23" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">150 × 1.2 = £180</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.text: Up 20% keeps the whole 100% and adds 20%, so you end with 120%. 120% is 1.2, the [[multiplier]], so £150 up 20% is 150 × 1.2 = £180.

pages.alt: A percentage bar. Above it, a bracket marks the old amount, 100 percent equals 40 amps. It is shaded to 115 percent. Below it, a bracket marks the new amount, 115 percent equals 46 amps. At the foot: 40 times 1.15 equals 46 amps, with times 1.15 highlighted.
pages.name: Up 15%
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="277.39" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="277.39" y1="22" x2="277.39" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="148.69" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = 40 A</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="296" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="295" height="38" rx="1"/><g><line x1="277.39" y1="37" x2="277.39" y2="75" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2px"/></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="316" y2="86" class="s1"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s1"/><line x1="316" y1="81" x2="316" y2="91" class="s1"/></g><g><rect x="113.19" y="94" width="109.61" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="168" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">115% = 46 A</text></g><g><rect x="207.59" y="128" width="61.19" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="179.84" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">40 × 1.15 = 46 A</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.task: A 40 A load goes up 15%. What is it now?
pages.why: Up 15% ends at 115% of the load, which is 1.15. 40 × 1.15 = 46 A. 15% of 40 A is only 6 A, so adding 15 A adds too much.

Inside the bar, the cut is named, minus 15 percent. At the foot: 80 times 0.85 equals 68 pounds, with times 0.85 highlighted.
pages.name: Down 15%
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.25px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}.s2{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="316" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="316" y1="22" x2="316" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="168" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = £80</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="296" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="250.60" height="38" rx="1"/><g><text x="293.8" y="53" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">−15%</text><text x="293.8" y="69" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">£12</text></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="271.6" y2="86" class="s2"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s2"/><line x1="271.6" y1="81" x2="271.6" y2="91" class="s2"/></g><g><rect x="91.49" y="94" width="108.61" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="145.8" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">85% = £68</text></g><g><rect x="205.09" y="128" width="71.12" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="177.84" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">80 × 0.85 = £68</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.text: Down 15% takes 15% from the 100%, which leaves 85%. 85% is 0.85, the multiplier, so £80 down 15% is 80 × 0.85 = £68.

pages.alt: A percentage bar. Above it, a bracket marks the old amount, 100 percent equals 60 pounds. It is shaded to 80 percent. Below it, a bracket marks the new amount, 80 percent equals 48 pounds. Inside the bar, the cut is named, minus 20 percent. At the foot: 60 times 0.8 equals 48 pounds, with times 0.8 highlighted.
pages.name: Down 20%
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.25px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}.s2{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="316" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="316" y1="22" x2="316" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="168" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = £60</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="296" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="235.8" height="38" rx="1"/><g><text x="286.4" y="53" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">−20%</text><text x="286.4" y="69" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">£12</text></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="256.8" y2="86" class="s2"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s2"/><line x1="256.8" y1="81" x2="256.8" y2="91" class="s2"/></g><g><rect x="87.48" y="94" width="101.82" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="138.4" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">80% = £48</text></g><g><rect x="217.31" y="128" width="58.34" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="190.10" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">60 × 0.8 = £48</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.task: A £60 price comes down 20%. Which sum gives the new price?
pages.why: Taking 20% off leaves 80% of the price, and 80% is 0.8. 60 × 0.8 = £48. 60 × 0.2 = £12 is the 20% taken off, not what is left.

pages.task: A £200 quote goes up 3%. Which multiplier gives the new price?

pages.name: Drag to what is left
pages.task: A £120 order has 25% off. Drag the end of the bar to what is left, then pick the new price.
pages.why: 25% off leaves 75% of the order, so the end goes to 75%. That is × 0.75, and 120 × 0.75 = £90. £30 is the 25% taken off.

pages.alt: A percentage bar. Above it, a bracket marks the old amount, 100 percent equals 40 amps. It is shaded to 200 percent. Below it, a bracket marks the new amount, 200 percent equals 80 amps. Inside the bar, the rise is named, plus 100 percent. At the foot: 40 times 2 equals 80 amps, with times 2 highlighted.
pages.name: Up 100%
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{fill:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="160.95" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="160.95" y1="22" x2="160.95" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="90.47" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = 40 A</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="281.90" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="280.90" height="38" rx="1"/><g><line x1="160.95" y1="37" x2="160.95" y2="75" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2px"/></g><g><text x="231.42" y="53" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">+100%</text><text x="231.42" y="69" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">40 A</text></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="301.90" y2="86" class="s2"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s2"/><line x1="301.90" y1="81" x2="301.90" y2="91" class="s2"/></g><g><rect x="102.58" y="94" width="116.74" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="160.95" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">200% = 80 A</text></g><g><rect x="229.90" y="128" width="38.90" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="202.15" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">40 × 2 = 80 A</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.text: Up 100% adds the whole amount again, so 40 A doubles to 80 A. That is 200% of it, a multiplier of 2.

pages.alt: A percentage bar. Above it, a bracket marks the old amount, 100 percent equals 30 metres. It is shaded to 250 percent. Below it, a bracket marks the new amount, 250 percent equals 75 metres. Inside the bar, the rise is named, plus 150 percent. At the foot: 30 times 2.5 equals 75 metres, with times 2.5 highlighted.
pages.name: 150% longer
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 158" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="158"><style>.s0{stroke:#5f6670;stroke-width:2px;stroke-linecap:round}.s1{fill:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle}.s2{stroke:#1d1f22;stroke-width:2.5px;stroke-linecap:round}</style><g><line x1="20" y1="27" x2="138.4" y2="27" class="s0"/><line x1="20" y1="22" x2="20" y2="32" class="s0"/><line x1="138.4" y1="22" x2="138.4" y2="32" class="s0"/><text x="79.2" y="16" text-anchor="middle" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.75px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">100% = 30 m</text><rect x="20" y="36" width="296" height="40" rx="2" style="fill:#fafaf8;stroke:#a9afb6;stroke-width:2px"/><rect x="21" y="37" width="295" height="38" rx="1"/><g><line x1="138.4" y1="37" x2="138.4" y2="75" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2px"/></g><g><text x="227.2" y="53" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">+150%</text><text x="227.2" y="69" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">45 m</text></g><g><line x1="20" y1="86" x2="316" y2="86" class="s2"/><line x1="20" y1="81" x2="20" y2="91" class="s2"/><line x1="316" y1="81" x2="316" y2="91" class="s2"/></g><g><rect x="109.50" y="94" width="116.99" height="26" rx="8"/><text x="168" y="112" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle">250% = 75 m</text></g><g><rect x="209.54" y="128" width="58.23" height="25" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="182.40" y="146" text-anchor="start" style="stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke">30 × 2.5 = 75 m</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.task: A 30 m cable run is made 150% longer. How long is it now?
pages.why: 150% longer keeps all 100% and adds 150%, so it ends at 250%, × 2.5. 30 × 2.5 = 75 m. 45 m is 150% of 30 m, which is the extra on its own.

pages.task: A 230 V supply drops 4% along a cable. What voltage is left?
pages.why: Dropping 4% leaves 96%, which is 0.96. 230 × 0.96 = 220.8 V. Taking off 4 volts would only be a drop of about 1.7%.

pages.task: A £50 tool has 8% off. Which multiplier gives the new price?
pages.why: 8% off leaves 92%, and 92% is 0.92. 50 × 0.92 = £46. × 0.08 finds the £4 taken off, and × 1.08 would add 8%.
